title: cardamine pratensis subsp. dentata
intro: Cardamine pratensis subsp. dentata, commonly known as toothwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa, and is known for its potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cardamine pratensis subsp. dentata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
